items_flat.title_en: Astra reaches Azure Foundry as Altman apologizes for a messy ChatGPT rollout
items_flat.title_zh: Astra 登陸 Azure Foundry，Altman 為 ChatGPT 混亂開量致歉
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft said GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s newest frontier model, is rolling out through the Microsoft Foundry Limited Access Program, with availability expanding to participating customers over coming days. On X, Sam Altman apologized for a messy ChatGPT rollout, said the team would try to make it right, and added that a broader wave to API customers and ChatGPT subscribers should begin soon, starting with Pro. OpenAI’s Sept. 3 product post still frames Astra as limited at launch, not generally available.
items_flat.summary_zh: 微軟表示 OpenAI 最新前沿模型 GPT-6 Astra 正透過 Microsoft Foundry Limited Access Program 開量，並將在數日內擴大給參與客戶。Sam Altman 在 X 為 ChatGPT 混亂開量致歉，稱團隊會設法補救，並表示 API 與 ChatGPT 訂戶的較廣開放即將開始、先從 Pro 著手。OpenAI 9/3 產品說明仍強調 Astra 尚未全面開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story has shifted from launch claims to distribution: computer-use capability only matters if paying customers can actually select the model. Capacity, Trusted Access gating, and whether Azure/API timing matches ChatGPT remain the open variables.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 焦點已從發表會宣稱轉到實際開量：電腦操作能力要等付費用戶選得到模型才算數。產能、Trusted Access 門檻，以及 Azure／API 時程是否對上 ChatGPT，仍是未定數。
items_flat.quote: first, sorry for the messy rollout. second, when we screw up, we try to make it right. third, we should be able to begin broad rollout to API customers and chatgpt subscribers in the near future. as usual we will start with pro subscribers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 第一，混亂的開量抱歉。第二，搞砸了我們會設法補救。第三，我們應能很快開始對 API 客戶與 ChatGPT 訂戶較廣開量，照慣例會先從 Pro 訂戶開始。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI banks daily Astra resets for paid users still locked out
items_flat.title_zh: 付費用戶尚未用到 Astra，OpenAI 改發每日重置額度補償
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT lead Tibo said the company will give one banked reset for every day a paid ChatGPT plan does not have Astra access, with the first credit landing about three hours after the Sept. 3 post. Altman separately told users he hoped some could try Astra over the weekend but could not promise it. ChatGPT release notes still list Astra as rolling out only to a limited set of organizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI Codex／ChatGPT 負責人 Tibo 表示，付費 ChatGPT 方案只要當天還用不到 Astra，就會累積一筆重置額度，第一筆約在 9/3 貼文後三小時入帳。Altman 另稱希望部分用戶週末能用到，但不能保證。ChatGPT 更新說明仍寫 Astra 僅向有限組織開量。
items_flat.analysis_en: Compensating unused days is an admission that demand outran serving capacity. It does not by itself confirm when Plus versus Pro versus Enterprise seats actually flip on.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 用「沒用到就補額度」等於承認需求超過供給。這本身仍不能確認 Plus、Pro、Enterprise 何時真正開到。
items_flat.quote: We will give one banked reset for every day you don't have access to Astra on your paid ChatGPT plan, starting today. Team is moving mountains to give access as fast as we can.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從今天起，你的付費 ChatGPT 方案只要當天還沒有 Astra 權限，我們就會存一筆重置額度。團隊正盡全力盡快開放。

brief_en: Quiet start to Saturday Taipei time. No new flagship model launches in the last 12 hours. The live thread is GPT-6 Astra’s enterprise expansion: Microsoft said Astra is in Foundry’s Limited Access Program, and Sam Altman apologized for a messy ChatGPT rollout while promising a broader Plus/Pro/API wave soon.
brief_zh: 台北週六清晨偏靜。近12小時無新旗艦模型發布。主線是 GPT-6 Astra 企業落地：微軟稱已進 Foundry 有限存取計畫，Altman 為 ChatGPT 混亂開量致歉，並稱付費用戶與 API 較廣開放在即。
